svg.title: Smart Home for AgentBuff: before and after
svg.desc: Before: Open the Smart Life app and tap through rooms to switch things off.. After: Say "turn off the bedroom lights" in chat and the agent does it.. Before: Community Tuya MCP servers need a developer cloud project or a computer on the home network.. After: One end-user key from tuya.ai, pasted once into a 3-step wizard. The service runs in the cloud behind a login.. Before: An AC with only an infrared remote stays outside every routine.. After: Pick the AC brand, test a remote code once, and the AC works from the app and from chat like any other AC.. Before: Tuya's end-user API has no scenes and no rules that react to sensors.. After: Scenes, schedules and if-this-then-that automations are stored and run by the service.. Before: An agent says "done" when the cloud only accepted the command.. After: The server reads the device state back and tells the agent when a change is not confirmed yet..
svg.text: What changed for the people who use it.
Open the Smart Life app and tap through rooms to switch things off.
Say "turn off the bedroom lights" in chat and the agent does it.
Community Tuya MCP servers need a developer cloud project or a
One end-user key from tuya.ai, pasted once into a 3-step wizard. The
service runs in the cloud behind a login.
An AC with only an infrared remote stays outside every routine.
Pick the AC brand, test a remote code once, and the AC works from the
app and from chat like any other AC.
Tuya's end-user API has no scenes and no rules that react to sensors.
Scenes, schedules and if-this-then-that automations are stored and run
An agent says "done" when the cloud only accepted the command.
The server reads the device state back and tells the agent when a change
